readerKeyTable.decision: No Property Explorer change. Every key the brief and the card render is supplied by the corrected bake in the shape the reader already handles (it is the shape production served until the 2026-08-28 cutover); the only reader-visible novelties (acreage.method cad-roll-land-acres, landUse.vintage nullable, provenance.parcelJoin) are accepted by the existing code paths. A reader change would have hidden the bake defect instead of fixing it.

operatorAnswer: No UI change is needed: the Property Explorer reads the same keys it always read (baseFacts, zoning, envelope, facetCoverage, provenance, bakedAt) and renders their absence honestly; the conformant bake had stopped writing them, so the fix is the bake, and the reader is unchanged.
